## #1 — podperson — 2010-06-07
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/5834/post-43391>

Particle City

Attached is a script for procedurally generating cities as particle systems.

The script goes in your Script/Particle folder.

Also included is a sample file which shows two instances of the particle system in use, one to place the "blocks" and another to place the "buildings" (both are cubes in the example).

This is (or will be) all documented here.

Attachments: [Particle City.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/10954/), [Particle City Example.jpg](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/10955/), [Screen shot 2010-06-07 at 3.10.47 PM.png](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/10956/)
